objective: Determine whether the pooled conditional movement-quality information previously carried by qfull is explained by causal candidate-route topology and current-state rotation, by unique cycle identity, by cycle-current-state interaction, or by the last-three-state history token.
non_objectives: changing any frozen per-loop quality grade
promoting cycle_07, cycle_09, cycle_13, or any other cycle
constructing P&L, a strategy, an order, a position, or a deployment path
opening or modifying either prospective shadow
using 2025, backward-2023, or partial-2026 as prospective validation

periods.oof_schedule: For each July-December month, fit new ablation models only on strictly earlier 2024 months and predict that month.

frozen_lineage.state_model: frozen eight-state causal semi-Markov detector fitted on 2024
frozen_lineage.cycles: the frozen twenty compatible fixed cycles

cohort_and_targets.unit: the exact frozen compatible anchor-cycle row
cohort_and_targets.positive_overlap_weight: 1 / number of positive frozen-cycle labels at the anchor
cohort_and_targets.ordered_classes_and_thresholds: exact frozen 2024 P75 and P90 classes from per_loop_movement_quality_v1
cohort_and_targets.conditional_surface: q75 and q90 on realized-loop rows with inverse-overlap weights
cohort_and_targets.joint_surface: the unchanged frozen structural probability s(i,c) multiplied by each conditional q75 or q90

shared_model_specification.temperature_reason: All twelve frozen qcontext and qfull OOF selections chose 1.0; fixing 1.0 prevents calibration tuning from confounding the feature ablation.
shared_model_specification.numeric_imputation_and_scaling: exact frozen 2024 medians and StandardScaler(with_mean=False) construction from per_loop_movement_quality_v1
shared_model_specification.shared_context_features: frozen current-state one-hot plus the exact nine causal numeric controls

candidate_rotation_construction.cycle_core: remove the repeated terminal state from the frozen cycle string
candidate_rotation_construction.compatible_rotations: all deduplicated rotations of the cycle core whose first state equals the causally filtered current state, each closed by appending the current state
candidate_rotation_construction.aggregation: uniform arithmetic mean over all compatible rotations; structural probability, realized route, and future states may not weight or select a rotation
candidate_rotation_construction.candidate_next_state_distribution: for each of eight states, the fraction of compatible rotations whose first future destination is that state
candidate_rotation_construction.future_route_state_composition: for each of eight states, the mean fraction of the transition-length future destinations occupying that state across compatible rotations
rotation_ambiguity_features: entropy of the candidate-next-state distribution divided by log(8), with zero for a point mass
candidate_rotation_construction.causality_rule: Every topology value must be computable from the frozen cycle definition and current filtered state before the next provider bar exists.

frozen_centroid_features.state_index: the frozen semantic state ID 0 through 7; the means array was estimated after semantic remapping
frozen_centroid_features.normalization: for each of fourteen dimensions, center and population-standardize across the eight frozen state centroids only; a zero-dispersion dimension becomes zero
blocks: expected standardized centroid of the candidate next-state distribution, width 14
expected standardized centroid of the future-route state composition, width 14
expected next-state centroid minus the standardized current-state centroid, width 14
frozen_centroid_features.historical_volume_note: Two frozen emission-centroid dimensions were derived from provider historical_volume during the original 2024 state fit. They are frozen semantic coordinates, not a new current-row volume feature, exchange-wide volume, or order flow.

qcontext.implementation: reuse the exact sealed qcontext OOF and scoring probabilities; do not refit

qroute_topology.role: test whether semantic candidate route topology explains the pooled signal

qcycle_main.features: shared context plus frozen cycle one-hot
qcycle_main.role: competing cycle-identity representation; qcycle_main versus qroute_topology is explicitly non-nested

qcycle_state.role: test incremental current-state rotation information beyond cycle main effect

qfull.features: the exact existing qcycle feature set: shared context, cycle main, cycle-by-current-state, and cycle-by-last-three-state history token
qfull.implementation: reuse the exact sealed qcycle/qfull OOF and scoring probabilities; do not refit

fair_comparison_rules.qcontext_and_qfull_replay_scope: every OOF and scoring probability plus all frozen aggregate losses
fair_comparison_rules.qcycle_main_vs_qroute_topology_interpret: paired non-nested representation comparison; superiority is evidence that explicit cycle identity represents information not retained by the chosen topology summary, but is not a formal conditional-variable test

primary_loss_pooling.definition: two targets times three horizons times two tiers
primary_loss_pooling.within_cell_weighting: frozen inverse-overlap weight on conditional rows and unit weight on compatible rows for the joint surface
primary_loss_pooling.pooled_loss: arithmetic mean of the twelve within-cell weighted mean losses so P75 prevalence cannot dominate P90
primary_loss_pooling.paired_daily_series: within each session compute the twelve available within-cell weighted candidate-minus-baseline loss differences, then take their arithmetic mean
primary_loss_pooling.paired_quarter_and_stock_series: the same equal-cell construction within every required quarter and every leave-one-stock-out deletion

multiplicity_and_uncertainty.method: five predeclared one-sided 99% moving-block intervals, equivalent to Bonferroni alpha 0.01 per primary comparison

topology_signal_retention_gate.precondition: sealed qfull must reproduce and pass versus qcontext on the pooled conditional and joint surfaces
topology_signal_retention_gate.noninferiority_margin: ten percent of the positive qfull-versus-qcontext pooled gain, calculated separately for each loss and surface
topology_signal_retention_gate.each_cell_rule: qroute_topology must retain at least 75% of the positive qfull gain where qfull improves; a cell with non-positive qfull gain is descriptive and cannot make retention pass

calibration_bins_and_support.base_cycle_support: exact frozen support rules from per_loop_movement_quality_v1
calibration_bins_and_support.unsupported_slice: reported as unsupported, never counted as a pass

causal_slices: candidate-next-state entropy quartile using 2024-frozen cut points
rotation_level_diagnostics.evaluation_only_slice: realized compatible rotation identity may be reconstructed after the outcome solely as a descriptive label; it may never enter a model, calibrator, selector, or confirmatory gate
rotation_level_diagnostics.required_quarters: both OOF quarters or all four scoring quarters
rotation_level_diagnostics.source_attribution_no_sign_reversal_rule: For a claimed source comparison, no supported causal current-state or rotation-ambiguity slice may have positive candidate-minus-baseline pooled log-loss and Brier differences.
rotation_level_diagnostics.multiple_rotation_aggregation_audit: independently reproduce every compatible rotation, deduplication, uniform mixture, next-state distribution, composition vector, and entropy

absolute_movement_axis.inputs: raw frozen observed exceedance rates and model mean q75/q90
absolute_movement_axis.status: post-result exploratory, not eligible for a frozen grade

incremental_vs_context_axis.inputs: paired proper-loss, calibration, block interval, quarter, stock-deletion, and rotation-slice comparisons
incremental_vs_context_axis.exploratory_hypothesis_already_identifie: cycle_09 is the strongest prior incremental candidate but failed robustness

two_axis_reporting.required_output: Report both axes side by side for every cycle without combining them into a single score or tier.

source_attribution_decision_rules.no_reference_signal: qfull fails exact replay or its frozen pooled improvement versus qcontext is not positive and robust
source_attribution_decision_rules.topology_sufficient: qroute_topology passes versus qcontext, passes the topology-retention gate versus qfull, and none of qcycle_main-versus-qroute, qcycle_state-versus-qcycle_main, or qfull-versus-qcycle_state passes its superiority gate
source_attribution_decision_rules.topology_dominant_with_residual_detail: qroute_topology passes retention, and one or more predeclared identity, state-rotation, or history increments also passes
source_attribution_decision_rules.cycle_identity_representation_needed: qcycle_main passes the non-nested superiority gate versus qroute_topology; describe this as representation evidence, not a conditional-variable proof
source_attribution_decision_rules.unresolved: qfull reference signal exists but topology retention fails and no deeper superiority comparison passes robustly
source_attribution_decision_rules.cell_level_label_restriction: A pooled attribution may not be generalized to a target, horizon, tier, cycle, or rotation whose own supported diagnostic reverses sign.

period_transfer_rule.provisional_source_attribution: determined from frozen July-December 2024 causal OOF only
period_transfer_rule.pre_score_freeze: all 2024 predictions, gates, attribution labels, model parameters, topology mappings, source hashes, and code hashes must be frozen before the scoring runner is permitted to load 2025 or 2023 row-level outcomes
period_transfer_rule.2025_and_2023_rule: recalculate every applicable superiority, retention, calibration, interval, quarter, stock, and rotation diagnostic
period_transfer_rule.retention_across_periods: a 2024 attribution is portable only when the required paired direction remains non-positive in both later periods and all later support and noninferiority gates pass

stop_rules: Stop before fitting if any pinned input hash, cohort reconstruction, cycle definition, state-centroid shape, semantic state index, threshold, control, label, or overlap weight fails audit.
Stop before fitting if any topology feature depends on a realized future state, realized rotation, future duration, outcome, session end, price after the anchor, or stock identity.
Stop before interpretation if sealed qcontext or qfull probabilities and losses fail exact replay at tolerance 1e-12.
Stop before scoring later periods if any 2024 fold is non-causal, a model fails convergence, probabilities are non-finite or not nested, pooled support fails, or an independent pre-score audit fails.
Stop source attribution and report no_reference_signal if the sealed qfull reference signal does not pass its precondition.
Stop a comparison family at unconfirmed when its 2024 primary gate fails; 2025 or 2023 may not revive or promote it.
Stop and require a separately frozen V3 contract for any feature, scale, penalty, calibration, threshold, support, rotation aggregation, or gate change suggested after results are read.
Stop immediately if either prospective shadow, any 2026 outcome, or any live, demo, paper, broker, order, position, deployment, or strategy path would be read or changed.
